One line: CMP-GAM-004, Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6, 80.000 (=80,000) PCS in 16 packages, gross weight 256 kg. Remark: protect from moisture. Signed as received by 'Meyer K.' (handwritten). observations: Handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' on the 'Odebrał' (received by) line; no receiving date or receiving stamp is present.
Item description is cut off at 'Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PE' with no closing parenthesis.
Quantity '80.000' uses the Polish thousands separator and is read as 80000.
No ordered quantity is shown, so delivered quantity cannot be compared against the order.
